services.desc: Enjoy all the awesome parts of summer camp while getting to enjoy the comfort of home each night! Our day camps are great for those who want to have the summer camp experience without the overnight commitment! Whether they are trying out a rock climbing wall, giving the slingshots a test, going on scavenger hunts, or working on building bug mansions, they will have a bundle of fun out at camp! services.desc: Camp Warwa has been offering high-quality, affordable outdoor education programs since 1980. We offer a variety of accommodations, hearty meals and professionally facilitated outdoor programs. Over 8,000 people participate in Camp Warwa programs every year, representing hundreds of local schools, scout groups, guide troupes and sports teams. We are committed to offering you the best experience we can while maintaining rates that give you top value. The Camp Warwa Outdoor Education Center offers many programs suitable for all ages.
